s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and syncope in a patient with complex congenital heart disease
salient_findings: Tachycardia with heart rate of 183 bpm
Irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating on ECG
key_facts: Patient has complex congenital heart disease
Patient has D-transposition of the great arteries
Patient has single ventricle physiology
Patient has a large ventricular septal defect with outflow extension
Patient has Fontan circulation
Patient was prescribed diltiazem and apixaban
Patient experienced persistent tachycardia and palpitations
ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
Transesophageal echocardiogram showed no intracardiac thrombus
ECG after diltiazem administration showed regular narrow complex tachycardia
ECG with adenosine showed temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia

raw.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and syncope in a patient with complex congenital heart disease
salient_findings: Tachycardia with heart rate of 183 bpm
Irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating on ECG
key_facts: Patient has complex congenital heart disease
Patient has D-transposition of the great arteries
Patient has single ventricle physiology
Patient has a large ventricular septal defect with outflow extension
Patient has Fontan circulation
Patient was prescribed diltiazem and apixaban
Patient experienced persistent tachycardia and palpitations
ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
Transesophageal echocardiogram showed no intracardiac thrombus
ECG after diltiazem administration showed regular narrow complex tachycardia
ECG with adenosine showed temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG showed irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, and after diltiazem administration, it converted to a regular narrow complex tachycardia, which is consistent with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia. Additionally, the ECG with adenosine showed temporary heart block with continuation of supraventricular tachycardia, further supporting this diagnosis.

rejected.label: arrhythmia
rejected.why: Too broad, as the patient's symptoms are more specific to supraventricular tachycardia

rejected.label: atrial fibrillation
rejected.why: The ECG after diltiazem administration showed a regular rhythm, which is not typical of atrial fibrillation

rejected.label: ventricular tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG showed a narrow complex tachycardia, which is more consistent with supraventricular tachycardia

rejected.label: pheochromocytoma
rejected.why: There is no evidence of hypertension or other symptoms typical of pheochromocytoma
